meta.title: gift.ceo — Only CEOs give here
meta.description: A public list of gifts given personally by CEOs, under their own name and their company's name. One seat per company, 10,000 CHF once, forever.

hero.sub: One seat per company. 10,000 CHF, once, forever. Then give as much as you like.

founding.note: The first ten companies pay nothing — they publish first, while the page is still empty.
founding.gone: All ten founding seats are taken. A seat is 10,000 CHF, once.
founding.why: The fee is a filter. The founding ten pass a different filter, by giving first.

intro.body: Every gift on this site is given personally by a CEO, under their own name and their company's name. A free tool for the world. A bonus for the team. Equity for the people who built the company. A day of mentoring. No press releases, no agencies — just a CEO saying: here is what we give.

how.title: How it works
how.step1: Sign in with your company's Google account. That's how we know it's really your company.
how.step2: Buy your company's seat: 10,000 CHF, once. It belongs to the company, forever — if you move on, your successor takes it over.
how.step3: Give. Publish as many gifts as you like, whenever you like, with a validity date you choose.

why.title: Why 10,000 CHF, once
why.body: It's not the price of an ad. It's a filter. Only a CEO who truly wants to give will pay to do it publicly, under their own name. That's what makes every gift on this site real.

feed.title: The feed
feed.body: Gifts appear in the order they were given, numbered from #1. Companies appear in the order they joined. There is nothing else to buy.
feed.empty: No gifts yet. The first one will be #1.

footer.smallprint: gift.ceo is a publishing platform. Each gift is published and signed by the person who declared themselves CEO of the company named, using that company's Google Workspace account. The one-time seat fee is non-refundable. gift.ceo does not verify or guarantee the gifts described.

join.title: Take your company's seat
join.no_hd: Sign in with your company Google Workspace account (@yourcompany.com).
join.domain_mismatch: That website does not match your Google Workspace domain.
join.ceo_name: Your name, as it should appear
join.declaration: I am the CEO (or equivalent top executive) of this company and authorized to publish on its behalf.
join.terms_accept: I have read and accept the Terms.
join.takeover_title: This company already has a seat
join.takeover_body: Someone at your company already bought the seat. You can take it over as the current CEO. The gifts already published keep the name of whoever gave them.

thanks.title: Your seat is being activated…
thanks.body: Payment received. This page will move on by itself as soon as the seat is live.
